description: Round 2, Creuss builds at home with no ships there: 4 infantry and a destroyer leave the infantry with no carrier to move them.
Round 3, Creuss meets Sway the Council (8 influence) but takes Leadership's secondary with the influence of all its planets, so Sway cannot be paid in the status phase.

Round 3, Creuss pays 4 trade goods for Technology's secondary, believing Negotiate Trade Routes was gone because another player scored it. Dimensional Splicer meets Diversify Research in its place, so the move passes the check; the misreading is graded by the rationale.
Round 4, six agents: Nekro builds 6 infantry on Mordai II with room for 1 aboard its ships there.
Round 4, six agents: Creuss sends a carrier with a ground force from its gate through the gravity rift, when a longer way around exists.
Round 1, six agents: the Barony stalls, spending a tactic token on an activation that does nothing.
